subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Crypto Ponzi Schemes
description: A micro-lesson that makes Crypto Ponzi Schemes usable.

hook.text: BitConnect promised 1% daily returns from a 'trading bot.' It was a Ponzi scheme using cryptocurrency.

buildup.text: Crypto Ponzis exploit hype and confusion. Victims don't understand the technology, so they trust the returns.

discovery.text: OneCoin, run by 'Cryptoqueen' Ruja Ignatova, stole $4 billion. She vanished and remains on the FBI's most wanted.

twist.text: OneCoin didn't even have a real blockchain. The entire cryptocurrency was fictional.

climax.text: New technology provides new disguises for old scams. The Ponzi structure is identical; only the wrapper changes.

punchline.text: No blockchain. No trading bot. Just old fraud in new tech.

quiz.question: What was unusual about OneCoin?
options: It didn't have a real blockchain at all
It was backed by a government
